in_hindi.name: Amishi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Love and Fertility
in_hindi.long_meaning: Amishi एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amishi is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Amrita, symbolizing love, fertility, and the divine nectar of immortality. In Hindu mythology, Amrita is a goddess revered for her nurturing, protective, and rejuvenating powers.
